# LiteGate Service Tag Reference

Generated by `internal/loader/tag_reference.go` from the parser's property lists; it lists every tag the gateway accepts. See the Service Tag DSL guide for usage.

## Two forms

| Form | Tags | Use |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Shortcut | `litegate.http.host/path/path_prefix/strip_path` | One route per service, no policy |
| Named resources | `litegate.entrypoints.*`, `litegate.http.routers.*`, `litegate.http.services.*`, `litegate.http.middlewares.*`, `litegate.http.serverstransports.*` | Several routes, middlewares, IDS, timeouts, retries |

The two forms cannot be mixed. Property paths are lowercase; resource names use lowercase letters, digits, `-` and `_`. Unknown properties, invalid references and conflicts reject the whole instance (fail closed); diagnostics appear in the dashboard and MCP `preview_service_tags`.

## Shortcut

| Tag | Value | Meaning |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `litegate.http.host` | host list | Unset: the catalog `default_domain` (`<service>.<default_domain>`) |
| `litegate.http.path` | path | Exact path; exclusive with path_prefix |
| `litegate.http.path_prefix` | path | Path prefix; `/` when neither is set. `litegate.http.pathprefix` is accepted too |
| `litegate.http.strip_path` | bool | Strip the matched path before forwarding |

The shortcut compiles to an ordinary Router named `main` with the Router defaults: attached to `web` and `websecure`, targeting the registering service with the default policy. Use named resources for any policy.

## Defaults

| Omitted | Effect |
| :--- | :--- |
| `routers.<name>.entrypoints` | Attached to `web` and `websecure` |
| `routers.<name>.service` | The only declared Service; the registering service with the default policy when none is declared; required when several are declared |
| Host condition | Any Host on the entrypoints |
| Both Host and path condition (and no rule) | Path prefix `/<service>` (`-` in the name becomes `/`), so services do not fight over the root |
| `services.<name>.discovery.name` | The registering service |

## EntryPoint

Prefix `litegate.entrypoints.<name>.`

| Property | Value | Meaning |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `address` | [ip]:port | Opens a new HTTP listener. The port must be listed in service_discovery.tag_entrypoints.allowed_ports and must not reuse a config.yaml entrypoint name or port. |
| `protocols` | http | Optional; tag-defined entrypoints only support http. |
| `tls.enabled` | bool | Whether the listener terminates TLS. |

## HTTP Router

Prefix `litegate.http.routers.<name>.`

| Property | Value | Meaning |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `entrypoints` | list | Entrypoints to attach to; default web,websecure. Any config.yaml entrypoint may be referenced. |
| `rule` | rule | Traefik-style rule such as Host(`a.com`) && PathPrefix(`/api`); exclusive with match.*. |
| `priority` | int | Higher values match first. |
| `middlewares` | list | Middleware names, applied in order. |
| `service` | name | Optional: the only declared Service, or the registering service with the default policy when none is declared. A named Service must be declared. |
| `match.hosts` | list | Host list; without a Host the Router matches any Host on its entrypoints. |
| `match.path` | path | Exact path; exclusive with match.path_prefix. |
| `match.path_prefix` | path | Path prefix. |
| `match.pathprefix` | path | Accepted spelling of match.path_prefix; both with different values is an error. |
| `match.methods` | list | HTTP methods. |
| `match.headers.<header>` | value | Request header equality; the header name keeps its case. |
| `match.query.<param>` | value | Query parameter equality. |
| `ids.provider` | name | IDS plugin name; setting it enables IDS. |
| `ids.operation` | name | Operation passed to the plugin, such as login, resolve or logout. |
| `ids.failpolicy` | deny \| allow | Behaviour when the plugin fails; default deny, allow fails open only when safe. |
| `ids.allowedheaders` | list | Headers the plugin may project to the upstream. |
| `ids.options.<key>` | value | Plugin option; the key keeps its case. |
| `observability.accesslogs` | bool | false silences this route's access log. |
| `observability.tracing` | bool | Always samples and exports this route's edge span (ignores sample_ratio); requires global tracing.enabled. |
| `observability.status.enabled` | bool | Enables the route's built-in status page. |
| `observability.status.path` | path | Status page path; default /_status. |
| `observability.status.showinstances` | bool | Whether the status page lists instances. |

## HTTP Service

Prefix `litegate.http.services.<name>.`

| Property | Value | Meaning |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `discovery.name` | name | Optional; when set it must equal the registering service (a Service always describes it). |
| `discovery.selector.match.<key>` | value | Hard boundary: only instances whose metadata `<key>` equals the value. |
| `discovery.selector.meta.<key>` | value | Soft preference: matching instances first, falling back to the complete hard-match set. |
| `timeout` | duration | End-to-end timeout of one request, e.g. 30s or 500ms; bounds only the handshake of an upgrade request. |
| `loadbalancer.strategy` | strategy | Load-balancing strategy: round_robin, weighted, weighted_round_robin, least_conn, p2c, ip_hash, cookie, or a plugin strategy. |
| `loadbalancer.server.port` | port | Overrides the instance port; 0 or unset uses the reported port. |
| `loadbalancer.server.scheme` | http \| https \| h2c \| grpc \| grpcs | Upstream protocol. |
| `loadbalancer.serverstransport` | name | ServersTransport to use. |
| `healthcheck.path` | path | Active health-check path. |
| `healthcheck.interval` | duration | Active health-check interval. |
| `retry.attempts` | int | Retry attempts. |
| `circuitbreaker.enabled` | bool | Enables the circuit breaker. |
| `circuitbreaker.timeout` | seconds | How long the breaker stays open; default 60. |
| `circuitbreaker.maxrequests` | int | Requests allowed while half-open; default 1. |
| `circuitbreaker.tripthreshold` | int | Consecutive failures that trip the breaker; default 3. |

## ServersTransport

Prefix `litegate.http.serverstransports.<name>.`

| Property | Value | Meaning |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `tls.enabled` | bool | Use TLS to the upstream; scheme defaults to https. |
| `tls.insecureskipverify` | bool | Skip upstream certificate verification; not allowed with clientcertificate. |
| `tls.clientcertificate` | litemesh | Mutual TLS with the Litemesh identity. |

## HTTP Middleware

Written `litegate.http.middlewares.<name>.<type>.<property>=<value>`; the properties are the same as the `config` of that middleware type in site YAML and are validated by the middleware itself. Built-in types: `api_key`, `basic_auth`, `chain`, `circuit_breaker`, `compress`, `cors`, `headers`, `jwt_auth`, `limit_conn`, `mirror`, `ratelimit`, `redirect_regex`, `redirect_scheme`, `remote_auth`, `replace_path_regex`, `retry`, `rewrite`, `strip_prefix`. A middleware has exactly one type. `retry` and `circuit_breaker` are deprecated (still working, with a load-time warning); use the Service's `retry.attempts` and `circuitbreaker.*` instead.

## Other tags

| Tag | Scope | Meaning |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `litegate.enable` | provider | Docker/Swarm: explicitly opt the container in or out of discovery (true/false). Unset: any litegate.* label opts in. |
| `litegate.docker.network` | provider | Docker/Swarm: network whose address is used to reach the container. |
| `litegate.docker.usehostport` | provider | Docker: reach the container through its published host port (not supported on Swarm). |
| `litegate.instance.labels.<key>` | instance | Instance identity label, hard-matched by discovery.selector.match and IDS. A plain `<key>=<value>` metadata entry works too. |
| `litegate.instance.meta.<key>` | instance | Instance preference metadata, soft-matched by discovery.selector.meta with fallback. |
| `litegate.instance.weight` | instance | Load-balancing weight of this instance (positive integer). |
| `litegate.instance.gray` | instance | Marks this instance as a canary (gray) instance. |
| `litegate.instance.version` | instance | Instance version, exposed as the endpoint's version metadata. |
| `litegate.instance.debugheaders` | instance | Diagnostics: expose the selected upstream address and related debug headers on the response (true/false). |
| `litegate[.<group>].tcp.port / udp.port` | stream | Layer 4: the gateway listens on this port and forwards to the instance's registered port; the port must be in allowed_ports. |
| `litegate[.<group>].tcp.tls.enabled / auto_cert / domains / cert_file / key_file / min_version` | stream | TLS termination for the layer-4 TCP listener. |

Instance tags (`litegate.instance.*`) may differ per instance; routing and resource tags must be identical on every instance of a service.

## Removed

`litegate.ingress.*`, `litegate.route.*`, `litegate.router.*`, `litegate.service.*`, `litegate.upstream.*`, `litegate.middleware.*`, `litegate.ids.*`, `litegate.site.*`, `litegate.entrypoint.*`, `litegate.io.*`, `litegate-http-*` and any `litegate.http.*` key not listed above are removed. An instance carrying them is rejected as a whole.
